parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been translated into natural, conversational, and code-mixed Marathi using standard WhatsApp-style romanization. Family dynamics are respected: Aarav addresses his father with polite plural forms ('bola', 'tumhala') and uses respectful pronouns ('tya') for Miss Nova, while Rahul speaks to his son in the warm 'tu' register. English terms like 'fluent', 'reels', 'mistakes', 'interview', and 'install' have been preserved to maintain the modern spoken register and avoid overly formal or Sanskritized Marathi.

violations.why: The script promises a guaranteed outcome of visible progress within a specific timeframe without using required hedge language like 'start to' or 'can'.
violations.fix: Change to: 'Tumhala 1 month-madhye visible progress disayla suruvat hou shakate.' (You can start seeing visible progress in 1 month.)

violations.why: It trashes Reels as a waste of time ('vel waste') instead of using it as a neutral time-reallocation anchor.
violations.fix: Change to: 'Reels scroll karnyapekshya, divasatun fakt 15 minutes bola.' (Instead of scrolling Reels, speak for just 15 minutes a day.)

violations.why: The visual contains a countdown timer, which is a prohibited misleading mechanic/fake UI element under Meta's ad policy.
violations.fix: Remove the countdown timer from the promotional graphic.

violations.quote: highlighting a prominent '1' rupee offer, with the original '30' rupee price crossed out. A countdown timer and a yellow 'Start Trial at ₹1' button are positioned at the bottom.
violations.why: The visual displays hard rupee prices (₹1 and ₹30) and unapproved promotional pricing, which must only come from the team.
violations.fix: Remove the specific rupee amounts and replace the button text with 'Start Free Trial' or 'Get Special Offer'.

safety.summary: The ad contains severe violations regarding hard rupee pricing (G6.1), a fake UI countdown timer (G4.2), and an unhedged progress guarantee (G1.1), alongside a moderate violation for trashing Reels (G2.1).
